page.title: Acceptance kit
page.intro: Each line opens its page in a new tab, with the account of its block.
page.disabled: The acceptance kit is disabled in this environment.
page.ownerRequired: The acceptance kit opens with an owner account.
page.pass: Pass opened by {owner}, valid for 12 hours.

dataset.title: Data set
dataset.counts: {folders} folders, {decks} presentations and {accounts} accounts, all prefixed {prefix}.

viewer.label: Viewer without access
viewer.summary: Signed-in account that was granted no access.

collab.label: Collaborator
collab.summary: Editor access to the shared folder, read access to “Lecture seule”.

expired.label: Expired access
expired.summary: Editor access to the shared folder, expired yesterday.

editor.label: Global editor
editor.summary: Edits, publishes and changes the metadata of every presentation.

owner.label: Owner
owner.summary: Also manages access, accounts and the trash.

anonymous.catalog: Publique and English deck are the only presentations listed.
anonymous.password: The page asks for the password {password}, then the presentation opens.
anonymous.passwordReload: The presentation opens without asking for the password again.
anonymous.private: The page redirects to the sign-in page.
anonymous.unlisted: The presentation opens through its direct link.
anonymous.imagePrivate: The image is not found, with a 404 answer.
anonymous.code: The code block is readable on its light background.
anonymous.english: The controls at the top right are in English, even when the interface is in French.

viewer.catalog: The catalog lists the same presentations as for the visitor.

collab.sharedFolder: “Publique”, “Mot de passe”, “Brouillon” and the English deck have a pencil. The New presentation button is present.
collab.sync: The header says Draft synced. A text typed in a second tab appears with the initial of the peer.
collab.pasteImage: A pasted image is inserted into the text.
collab.unpublished: After a change, the header and the card say Unpublished changes. Publishing removes that mention.
collab.password: The presentation opens without a password.
collab.readOnly: “Lecture seule” opens and its card has no pencil.
collab.private: Access is denied. No card offers the metadata or the sharing.

expired.catalog: Publique and English deck are the only presentations listed.

editor.catalog: The whole data set is listed, Brouillon included, with pencil and metadata.
editor.trash: The trash contains the presentation Corbeille, which can be restored.
editor.accountsDenied: The page is denied. The sharing panels are read-only.

owner.accounts: The list contains the five personas and the guest {handle}.
owner.sharedFolderAccess: The access panel lists the collaborator as editor, the expired access and the guest as viewer. An access can be changed, added by email and removed.
owner.language: The language button switches the interface to English. The choice is kept after a reload.
